shared_elements: upright rectangular slab as the decorated field
incised/carved linear signs arranged in horizontal rows
a bordered band running along the upper edge
repeated small units in a row
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing incised linear marks organised into horizontal bands, including a framed register along the top edge, but that is essentially the whole correspondence. A shows only abstract angular script-like signs with no figures, while B shows a dense figural programme of quadrupeds, birds and a row of animal heads carved in relief, with no comparable sign system.
